remediation_queue.title: Ensure firewall rules are configured and active
remediation_queue.affected_asset: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS servers using iptables or nftables firewall
remediation_queue.remediation_script: Configure host-based firewall rules according to server requirements. For Ubuntu systems, configure UFW or nftables rules and ensure default policies restrict unauthorized inbound traffic. Example: `ufw default deny incoming` and allow only required ports.

remediation_queue.affected_asset: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS servers using GRUB2 bootloader
remediation_queue.remediation_script: Configure authentication protection for GRUB2 by creating a GRUB administrator password using `grub-mkpasswd-pbkdf2`, adding the generated password hash to `/etc/grub.d/40_custom`, then regenerate the configuration with `update-grub`.
